title: Deciphering the interaction patterns of intermediates on single atom catalysts during electrocatalytic CO2 conversion reactions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,4783-4823
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00621J, Review Article
Dongfang Li, Xiaobo Zheng, Yufei Zhao, Jinqiang Zhang, Guoxiu Wang
This review presents a unified framework linking coordination in single atom catalysts to the active sites. By classifying intermediate binding patterns, we show how coordination engineering steers CO2 conversion pathways toward different products.
